name: single_merchant_purchase
scope: Compare at least two eligible offers where available, select one merchant and one order

nodes.output: verified quote references and mismatch evidence
ranked references to deterministic service calculations
durable operation and authorized external dispatch
seller draft; no unilateral shared-case conclusion

edge_conditions.intent->offers: Requirements sufficient and scoped task valid
edge_conditions.offers->payment_options: At least one usable quote; otherwise needs_human/no_offer
edge_conditions.human_approval->dispatch: Active signed/bound mandate and fresh quote; never ordinary chat acceptance
edge_conditions.fulfilment->seller_support: Only if seller requests help or an exception exists
edge_conditions.seller_support->case_review: Case opened and assigned; not every order
edge_conditions.case_review->knowledge_candidate: Case closed, result reconciled, purpose/de-identification/rights approved; phase 2 enabled

parallelism: Independent read queries only. Quote-dependent payment calculation follows quote resolution. Writes serialized by entity version and database constraints.

interruption.business_stop: Revoke mandate and prevent future dispatch commits independently of model availability
interruption.agent_cancel: Cancel unneeded model jobs after durable business stop; cancellation does not recall prior external dispatch
interruption.unknown_payment: Retain reservation, query/cancel/reconcile original operation; do not create a new debit

checkpoint: Persist workflow node, version, run attempt, lease/fencing value and command result; failed model calls cannot roll back already committed business facts.
